text: {"table": {"name": "trans", "purpose": "Bank account transaction records (PKDD'99 Czech financial dataset). One row per transaction on an account, with amount, resulting balance, operation type, and characterization. Czech labels throughout."}, "columns": {"col_001": {"role": "identifier", "name": "trans_id", "description": "Primary key; unique transaction identifier.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_002": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "account_id", "description": "Owning account; references account.col_001 (many transactions per account).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_003": {"role": "date", "name": "date", "description": "Transaction date (1993-01-01 to 1998-12-31).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_004": {"role": "code", "name": "transaction_type", "description": "Transaction type in Czech: PRIJEM = income/credit, VYDAJ = expense/debit, VYBER = cash withdrawal (recorded as debit).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_005": {"role": "code", "name": "operation", "description": "Operation mode in Czech: VYBER = cash withdrawal, VYBER KARTOU = card withdrawal, VKLAD = cash deposit, PREVOD NA UCET = transfer to another account (outgoing), PREVOD Z UCTU = transfer from another account (incoming). Null when type is VYBER (redundant with col_004).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_006": {"role": "numeric", "name": "amount", "description": "Transaction amount in Czech koruna (CZK); min 0, max 87,400, median 2,100.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_007": {"role": "numeric", "name": "balance", "description": "Account balance in CZK after the transaction; can be negative (min -41,126).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_008": {"role": "code", "name": "transaction_characterization", "description": "Bank's characterization of the transaction in Czech: UROK = interest credited, SLUZBY = bank services fee, SIPO = household/utility payment, DUCHOD = pension, SANKC. UROK = sanction (penalty) interest, POJISTNE = insurance, UVER = loan payment. Blank/null when not characterized.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_009": {"role": "code", "name": "partner_bank", "description": "Code of the partner bank for inter-bank transfers (two-letter codes, e.g. QR, AB, ST). Null for non-transfer transactions.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_010": {"role": "numeric", "name": "partner_account", "description": "Partner account number for inter-bank transfers (large integers up to ~99,994,199; 0 also occurs). Null for non-transfer transactions.", "status": "resolved"}}}
